info.title: Mechbase API
info.description: API for pushing measurements and managing industrial assets.

put.description: Idempotent upsert by external_id: 201 when created, 200 when updated. Requires external_id + name.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the section has zones or assets, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

post.description: Requires a parent section (section_id or section_external_id).

put.description: Idempotent PUT on the collection, keyed on external_id; requires a parent section and a name.

patch.description: Re-parenting a zone to another section is not allowed; delete and recreate instead.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the zone has assets, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

post.description: Requires a parent section (section_id or section_external_id). Zone optional, within that section.

put.description: Idempotent upsert by external_id; needs a parent section + name. Section immutable across upserts.

patch.description: Section is immutable. Zone can change within the section, or be cleared with zone_id=null.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the asset has measurement points, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

post.description: Requires a parent asset (asset_id or asset_external_id). PR points are auto-managed.

put.summary: Create-or-update a measurement point by external_id (upsert)
put.description: Idempotent upsert by external_id; needs a parent asset (immutable). Name auto-composed if omitted.

patch.description: The parent asset is immutable; delete and recreate to move a point.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the point has recorded measurements, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

get.summary: Legacy v1 URL → v2 MP map (for offline QR-code resolution)
get.description:
Return the full legacy-URL → v2 MP mapping for one installation.

Mobile clients fetch this once, cache it locally, and use it to resolve
old QR codes (encoded with v1 ``/plantlayer/<uuid>/`` or
``/measurementpoint/<uuid>/`` URLs) to the matching v2 measurement-point
detail page even when offline.

post.description: Record a measurement for a point (referenced by measurement_point_id or measurement_point_external_id). Optional fields: notes/session_id/timestamp. Pass external_id to make the write idempotent: a retried push with the same external_id returns the existing reading (200) instead of creating a duplicate (201). A 409 means the external_id is already bound to a different point.

post.summary: Create many measurements in one request (partial success)
post.description: Write up to 1000 readings in a single request. Each item is processed independently and idempotently (by external_id): the results array reports created / duplicate / error per item with its index, so one bad row never sinks the batch and re-sending the whole batch is safe. For nightly-sync volumes use a service token, which is exempt from the burst/sustained limits API-wide; human tokens are throttled normally.

post.summary: Create a measurement with file attachment
post.description: Record a new measurement with a file attachment. Send as multipart/form-data with a 'payload' JSON string field and a 'file' field. Honors external_id for idempotency, same as the JSON endpoint.

get.description: Offset paginated by default (limit/offset, includes total). Pass ?cursor= for keyset pagination over long timeframes — it skips the expensive COUNT and returns next_cursor instead of total. Filter either mode by created_from / created_to (ISO-8601).

post.summary: Upload a file to an existing measurement
post.description: Attach a file to an existing measurement. File kind is auto-detected from the filename and measurement point type.

patch.description: Replace the full set of analyst-confirmed thermal hotspots on a measurement's thermogram (the iOS lightbox edit flow). Full replacement: an empty list clears all hotspots. Recomputes status = max(threshold, worst severity) and re-propagates to point/asset. No server-side detection runs.

post.summary: Submit an item response with photo attachments
Create a route item + response during execution (field-authored)
Assign a zone-only field item to an asset

post.description: Device reports it is online and optionally sends per-service health.
Bulk upload measurements identified by DeviceMapping UUID. The server resolves each mapping_uuid to the correct MeasurementPoint.

post.summary: Attach a file to a MaintNode measurement
post.description: Upload a binary file (e.g. .dr waveform) and attach it to an existing measurement. File kind is auto-detected from filename and measurement point type.

get.description: Installation-wide flat measurement rows for BI / warehouse sync. Keyset-paginated: walk pages via next_cursor until it is null (no COUNT). Default browse mode is newest-first by measurement time. Pass ?updated_since=<ISO-8601> to switch to incremental mode: rows are returned oldest-changed-first by the updated_at watermark, so a backdated or re-finalized reading is re-emitted. The feed is at-least-once — dedupe on measurement_uuid (upsert by uuid) in the warehouse. Hard-deletes do not propagate (documented limitation). Filter by asset_id/asset_external_id, point_id/point_external_id, transducer_type, status (good|elevated|minor|major), and a created_from/created_to measurement-time window. The created_* window also constrains incremental pulls: a backdated or late-edited row whose updated_at advanced but whose measurement time falls outside the window will not re-emit, so leave created_* unset for a complete changed-since sync. ?format=csv streams the current page as CSV for a quick pull; use the export job for bulk.

get.summary: Flat alarm/audit events feed (cursor + filters + incremental)
get.description: Installation-wide audit/alarm events for BI / warehouse sync. Browse is newest-first; ?updated_since=<ISO-8601> switches to incremental, walking the immutable created_at watermark ascending. The watermark is inclusive and created_at is not unique, so the event(s) on the boundary re-emit on the next sync — at-least-once, dedupe on event_id (upsert by event_id) in the warehouse, same as the other feeds. Filter by action and a created_from/created_to window. ?format=csv streams the current page.

Installation-wide route inspection responses for BI / warehouse sync. Browse is newest-first; ?updated_since=<ISO-8601> switches to incremental by the updated_at watermark (at-least-once — dedupe on response_uuid). Filter by route_id (route uuid), status (good|elevated|minor|major), and a created_from/created_to window. ?format=csv streams the current page.

get.summary: Cached FFT spectra for one measurement
get.description: Returns the cached FFT arrays (freq + velocity/acceleration/envelope) for a measurement — the by-URL companion to the feed's spectra_url (arrays stay out of the row, #150). Installation-scoped: the measurement must belong to the path installation (no IDOR). Empty arrays when no spectra are cached.

post.description: Enqueue an async CSV or Parquet export of a dataset (measurements, events, or inspections) with the same filters as the live feed. Returns 202 with a status_url to poll; when the job is done the status response carries a short-lived signed download_url. Service tokens get the full row ceiling; interactive tokens are capped lower. Bounded per-installation concurrency — 429 if too many are already in flight.

get.description: Returns the job state (pending|running|done|failed|expired). When done and not yet expired, includes a freshly-signed download_url (the signature is short-lived; re-poll to refresh it).

Streams the generated file when the signed URL is valid and unexpired and the job is still available. 403 for a bad/expired signature, 410 when the export is still building, failed, or past its file TTL.

HotClusterIn.description:
A client-supplied (analyst-confirmed) thermal hotspot.

The iOS app runs detection on-device, an analyst confirms it, and pushes
the result. ``severity`` is a ``common.models.Status`` integer from the
same NETA bucketing the server uses; ``source`` is an audit-only hint
("auto" | "manual"). Coordinates are percentages of the frame so they
render unchanged by the existing overlay. See ``HotspotsIn`` /
``MeasurementIn.hot_clusters``.
HotClusterIn.title: HotClusterIn

MeasurementBatchResultOut.description:
Per-item outcome for a batch write. ``status`` is one of created /
duplicate / error. ``duplicate`` means an idempotent hit (external_id was
already recorded) — the existing reading is returned unchanged.
MeasurementBatchResultOut.title: MeasurementBatchResultOut

HotspotsIn.description:
Body for the hotspot-edit PATCH endpoint. Full replacement: the list
given replaces all stored hotspots, and ``[]`` clears them.
HotspotsIn.title: HotspotsIn

StartExecutionIn.description:
Optional body for starting a route execution.

Lets offline-first native clients mint the execution `uuid` locally and push
the start through their outbox when connectivity returns (item responses and
measurements already work this way). Both fields are optional, and a caller
that POSTs no body — or `{}` — keeps the original server-minted behavior so
the browser/web UI is unaffected. See issue #181.
StartExecutionIn.title: StartExecutionIn

FieldItemIn.description:
Create a RouteItem + ItemResponse in one call (field-authored survey item).

The item is zone-anchored (or route-level with ``zone_id=None``); the
technician triages it to a specific asset later via ``/triage``.
FieldItemIn.title: FieldItemIn

ExportFiltersIn.description:
Union of all feed filters for a bulk export request body. All optional +
length-bounded; the POST whitelists the subset relevant to the dataset.
ExportFiltersIn.title: ExportFiltersIn
